title: StudyOverview
description: Aggregate study-level summary shown in the Study Dashboard header panel. All cross-subject values are pre-aggregated; no raw per-subject data is exposed.

protocol_version.description: SemVer protocol version for this study.

subjects_by_condition.description: Map of condition label to subject count. Values must not contain raw subject data.

active_risk_alerts.description: Count of subjects with risk != none.

failed_cron_jobs.description: Aggregate count of failed cron jobs across all subjects.

hermes_provisioning_failures.description: Count of subjects where hermes_profile_id is null (BLOCKED_MISSING_HERMES_PROFILE_ID).

exports_pending.description: Number of redacted export jobs currently queued.

last_validation_run.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent validate-all-profiles run, or null if never run.
